scripts.refreshRecruitPresentation:
local v = ctx.v
v.onboardingPage = v.onboardingPage or 1

local preview = api.actorPreview(v.candidateActorId, v.candidateLevel or 1)
local actorData = preview and preview.actorData or {}
v.candidatePortraitKey = actorData.portrait or v.portraitKey
v.candidateSpriteKey = actorData.smallBattler or v.portraitKey

v.candidateRoster = {
    {
        name = v.candidateName or "?",
        level = v.candidateLevel or 1,
        hp = v.candidateHp or 0,
        maxHp = v.candidateMaxHp or 1,
        spriteKey = v.candidateSpriteKey,
        portraitKey = v.candidatePortraitKey,
        atk = v.atk or 0,
        def = v.def or 0,
        mat = v.mat or 0,
        mdf = v.mdf or 0,
    }
}

local mpd = v.mpdDelta or 0
if mpd > 0 then
    v.upkeepText = "+" .. tostring(mpd) .. " MP each battle round"
elseif mpd < 0 then
    v.upkeepText = tostring(math.abs(mpd)) .. " less MP each battle round"
else
    v.upkeepText = "No added MP upkeep"
end

local slotIdx = v.slotIdx or 1
local isReserve = slotIdx > 4
local slot = isReserve and (slotIdx - 4) or slotIdx
if isReserve then
    v.reserveCursor = slot
else
    v.lastActiveSlot = slot
end

local occupant = isReserve and api.reserve(slot) or api.party(slot)
if occupant and occupant.empty then occupant = nil end
local rosterName = isReserve and "RESERVE" or "ACTIVE"
v.destinationTitle = rosterName .. " " .. tostring(slot)
    .. " - " .. (occupant and occupant.name or "Empty")

if not occupant then
    v.destinationEffect = isReserve
        and "The candidate joins Reserve."
        or "The candidate joins the Active Party."
elseif not isReserve then
    local emptyReserve = nil
    for reserveSlot = 1, 4 do
        local reserveMember = api.reserve(reserveSlot)
        if not reserveMember or reserveMember.empty then
            emptyReserve = reserveSlot
            break
        end
    end
    if emptyReserve then
        v.destinationEffect = occupant.name .. " moves to Reserve " .. tostring(emptyReserve) .. "."
    else
        v.destinationEffect = occupant.name .. " moves to Town Storage."
    end
else
    v.destinationEffect = occupant.name .. " moves to Town Storage."
end

v.confirmText = (v.candidateName or "The candidate") .. " -> " .. v.destinationTitle
    .. "\n" .. v.destinationEffect
scripts.selectRecruit:
local v = ctx.v
if v.showOnboarding and (v.onboardingPage or 1) == 1 then
    v.onboardingPage = 2
else
    api.recruitment.onSelectRecruitScene(ctx)
end
scripts.navigatePlacementUp:
local v = ctx.v
if v.mode ~= 2 then return end
local slotIdx = v.slotIdx or 1
if slotIdx <= 4 then
    if slotIdx > 2 then v.slotIdx = slotIdx - 2 end
else
    local slot = slotIdx - 4
    if slot > 1 then slot = slot - 1 end
    v.reserveCursor = slot
    v.slotIdx = slot + 4
end
scripts.navigatePlacementDown:
local v = ctx.v
if v.mode ~= 2 then return end
local slotIdx = v.slotIdx or 1
if slotIdx <= 4 then
    if slotIdx <= 2 then v.slotIdx = slotIdx + 2 end
else
    local slot = slotIdx - 4
    if slot < 4 then slot = slot + 1 end
    v.reserveCursor = slot
    v.slotIdx = slot + 4
end
scripts.navigatePlacementLeft:
local v = ctx.v
if v.mode ~= 2 then return end
local slotIdx = v.slotIdx or 1
if slotIdx > 4 then
    v.reserveCursor = slotIdx - 4
    v.slotIdx = v.lastActiveSlot or 2
elseif slotIdx == 2 or slotIdx == 4 then
    v.slotIdx = slotIdx - 1
end
scripts.navigatePlacementRight:
local v = ctx.v
if v.mode ~= 2 then return end
local slotIdx = v.slotIdx or 1
if slotIdx <= 4 then
    if slotIdx == 1 or slotIdx == 3 then
        v.slotIdx = slotIdx + 1
    else
        v.lastActiveSlot = slotIdx
        local reserveSlot = v.reserveCursor or 1
        v.slotIdx = reserveSlot + 4
    end
end

content.text: {(v.mode or 1) == 1 and '[Confirm] Placement     [Cancel] Leave' or ((v.mode or 1) == 2 and '[Confirm] Place     [Cancel] Candidate' or '')}

scripts.navigateReserveLeft:
local v = ctx.v
if v.mode ~= 1 and v.mode ~= 4 then return end
if v.focusArea == "party" and v.cursorIdx % 2 == 0 then
    v.cursorIdx = v.cursorIdx - 1
    v.partyCursor = v.cursorIdx
end
scripts.navigateReserveRight:
local v = ctx.v
if v.mode ~= 1 and v.mode ~= 4 then return end
if v.focusArea == "party" and v.cursorIdx % 2 == 1 then
    v.cursorIdx = v.cursorIdx + 1
    v.partyCursor = v.cursorIdx
end
scripts.navigateReserveUp:
local v = ctx.v
if v.mode ~= 1 and v.mode ~= 4 then return end
if v.focusArea == "party" then
    if v.cursorIdx > 2 then
        v.cursorIdx = v.cursorIdx - 2
        v.partyCursor = v.cursorIdx
    else
        v.partyCursor = v.cursorIdx
        v.focusArea = "reserve"
        v.cursorIdx = v.reserveCursor or 4
    end
else
    if v.cursorIdx > 1 then v.cursorIdx = v.cursorIdx - 1 end
    v.reserveCursor = v.cursorIdx
end
scripts.navigateReserveDown:
local v = ctx.v
if v.mode ~= 1 and v.mode ~= 4 then return end
if v.focusArea == "party" then
    if v.cursorIdx <= 2 then v.cursorIdx = v.cursorIdx + 2 end
    v.partyCursor = v.cursorIdx
else
    if v.cursorIdx < 4 then
        v.cursorIdx = v.cursorIdx + 1
        v.reserveCursor = v.cursorIdx
    else
        v.reserveCursor = v.cursorIdx
        v.focusArea = "party"
        v.cursorIdx = v.partyCursor or 1
    end
end
scripts.setupReservePopup:
local v = ctx.v
local focusArea = v.focusArea
local cursorIdx = v.cursorIdx
local member = (focusArea == 'party') and api.party(cursorIdx) or api.reserve(cursorIdx)
local options = {}

if member and member.empty then member = nil end

v.popupTargetIsReserve = (focusArea == 'reserve')
v.popupTargetIndex = cursorIdx
v.popupMemberName = member and (member.name or "Unknown") or nil
v.popupMemberRef = member

-- Summoning belongs to a town ritual site. Sacrifice is disabled while its
-- inheritance-based replacement is designed. Expedition reserve only manages
-- creatures the player already committed to bringing below.
table.insert(options, {name = "Swap"})
if member and api.inDungeon() then
    table.insert(options, {name = "Dismiss"})
end
if member and api.canPromote(v.popupTargetIsReserve, v.popupTargetIndex) then
    table.insert(options, {name = "Promote"})
end
table.insert(options, {name = "Cancel"})

v.popupCount = #options
v.popupOptions = options
scripts.executeReservePopup:
local v = ctx.v
local opt = v.popupOptions[v.popupIdx].name
if opt == "Cancel" then
    v.mode = 1
    api.emit({ type = "close_window", windowId = "reserve_popup" })
elseif opt == "Swap" then
    v.mode = 4
    v.swapSourceIsReserve = v.popupTargetIsReserve
    v.swapSemanticSourceIndex = v.popupTargetIndex
    -- The legacy floating ghost is a spatial Active-Party affordance.
    -- Reserve pickup is represented by the list row highlight instead, so
    -- Reserve never enters the renderer's grid-slot coordinate path.
    v.swapSourceIndex = v.popupTargetIsReserve and nil or v.popupTargetIndex
    v.swapSourceFocus = v.focusArea
    api.emit({ type = "close_window", windowId = "reserve_popup" })
elseif opt == "Dismiss" then
    local member, result = api.dismissToStorage(v.popupTargetIsReserve, v.popupTargetIndex)
    v.mode = 1
    api.emit({ type = "close_window", windowId = "reserve_popup" })
    if member then
        v.statusText = member.name .. " returned to town storage (slot " .. result .. " )."
    else
        v.statusText = result or "Dismissal failed."
    end
elseif opt == "Promote" then
    v.ritualPush = "promote"
    v.mode = 1
    api.emit({ type = "close_window", windowId = "reserve_popup" })
end
scripts.executeSwap:
local v = ctx.v
local sourceIndex = v.swapSemanticSourceIndex or v.swapSourceIndex
api.swap(sourceIndex, v.swapSourceIsReserve, v.cursorIdx, v.focusArea == 'reserve')
if api.partyCount() <= 0 then
    api.swap(v.cursorIdx, v.focusArea == 'reserve', sourceIndex, v.swapSourceIsReserve)
    v.statusText = "Cannot leave the party empty!"
    v.mode = 1
    return
end
v.mode = 1
v.statusText = ""

content.text: {v.mode == 4 and 'Select a target to swap with.  [Cancel]: cancel' or ((v.statusText and v.statusText ~= '') and v.statusText or config.terms.help)}
